summary: Backend: 64/66 pytest passed (48/50 existing regression suite + 16/16 new iter1 feature tests). Markets, candles 1m/5m (bar step verified 60s/300s) with OB/FVG/structure, auth 401/200, plugins GET/PUT, signals 5m, backtest 1m/5m/1h with trend_filter/breakeven, walk-forward optimizer (BTC 1h -> best=null, EURUSD 1h -> RSI test +14.1% PF 1.55 56 trades, AAPL 1d -> MACD test +7.7% PF 2.59 14 trades — all satisfy best constraints), paper trading flow, bot GET/PUT(trend_filter)/run (opened source=bot positions with SL/TP, logs incl. 'stop demasiado curto' skip), background loop verified (last_run advanced while enabled), AI SSE (gpt-5.4 streams chunks then [DONE]). SMC BTC-USD 1h with trend filter+BE = +21.5% (PF 1.19, 172 trades) vs -8.5% unfiltered (previously -23%). Frontend (390x844): login via localStorage, Markets tabs, chart TF 1m/5m, overlay chips, AI analysis renders, buy sheet places order (persisted), Signals TF chips incl 1m/5m, plugins modal toggle+save persisted, Backtest option chips, Otimizar (opt-none and opt-best states), Aplicar (re-runs backtest with optimizer params — request body verified), Usar no Robô (server bot updated, bot screen shows new values), Bot screen toggle/trend filter/TF/save/run now/logs/back, Portfolio ROBÔ tags, close position, Histórico tab, reset. No red screens, no page errors. 2 backend failures + several logic/UX issues listed below.

minor.issue: Unknown symbol (e.g. ZZZ) returns 502 'Preço indisponível' (Cloudflare replaces body with HTML 502 page). Should validate symbol in ASSET_INFO and return 404/400. Same pattern in POST /positions/{id}/close. server.py:504-506
No range validation of plugin params: rsi.length=-5 (or 0) accepted and persisted; can break indicator computation for signals/backtest/bot. server.py:261-267 — add min/max per param (PLUGIN_META).
Opens trades even when bot.enabled=false (manual 'Verificar sinais agora' bypasses the switch). Confirm intended; otherwise guard or label clearly.

BTC-USD 1m returns 0 trades because every setup is skipped by the 'stop < 8*fee*price' rule (crypto fee too high for 1m ATR). Response has no reason field so UI just shows 0 trades/0%. Return a skipped_count / note so the UI can explain.

run_bot_cycle can run concurrently from background loop and POST /bot/run; last_bar dedupe is read from a stale dict, so the same bar may open duplicate positions in a race. Consider a per-user asyncio.Lock.

ui_bugs.issue: opt results are not tied to the symbol/tf they were computed for: card does not show the asset/tf, is not cleared when the user changes asset/tf chips, and Aplicar / Usar no Robô use the CURRENT symbol/tf state (backtest.tsx:86-98) — e.g. optimize EURUSD 1h, tap GBPUSD, Usar no Robô adds GBPUSD with EURUSD params. Use opt.data.symbol/opt.data.tf or reset opt on change.
Header label uses current tf state ({tf.toUpperCase()}) instead of r.tf, so changing TF chip after a run mislabels the results. backtest.tsx:186
1m crypto backtest shows 0 trades / +0% with no explanation (stops too tight vs fees). Show a hint.

integration_issues.issue: Bot config is global (one strategy/tf/params for all symbols). Using the optimizer result for one asset overwrites tf/strategy/params applied to every other bot symbol (verified: BTC-USD now trades with EURUSD-optimized RSI 1x/1.5 and tf changed 4h->1h). Warn user or support per-symbol configs.

issues: Top/bottom price-axis labels are clipped/overlapped (top label cut at chart edge; bottom label overlapped by area below); current-price tag overlaps an axis label.
'Repor conta simulada' resets the whole account (positions, history, bot logs) with one tap and no confirmation dialog.
Signals ignore the EMA200 trend filter (e.g. 'Tendência alta' + VENDA cards) while backtest/bot apply it by default — inconsistent with the strategy the user is backtesting.
Toggling the enable Switch immediately saves ALL unsaved edits in the form (tf, trend filter, etc.) — may surprise users; acceptable but consider documenting.

action_items: POST /api/orders (and close): validate symbol -> 404 instead of 502
PUT /api/plugins: enforce numeric ranges for plugin params (reject length<=0 etc.)
Backtest optimizer: store symbol/tf with opt result, show it in the card, clear on asset/tf change, use opt.data.symbol/tf in Aplicar/Usar no Robô
Backtest header: use r.tf not tf state
Return/display reason when backtest has 0 trades due to cost filter (esp. 1m crypto)
Add confirm dialog before portfolio reset
Decide whether /bot/run should work when bot disabled; add per-user lock around run_bot_cycle
Consider per-symbol bot params or warn that 'Usar no Robô' changes global bot config
critical_code_review_comments: Paper account has no margin accounting: each order only checks notional <= 10x balance, so unlimited stacked positions are possible (bot: up to max_positions x 10x).
Manual positions SL/TP only auto-close when GET /portfolio is called or when the user's bot loop runs (check_exits) — users without enabled bot never get server-side SL/TP execution.
Signal SL/TP in build_signal always uses 1.5 ATR / 2R regardless of user/bot settings.
Optimizer always uses breakeven=True; candidates don't include breakeven flag (frontend hardcodes setBreakeven(true)) — consistent but implicit.
Existing pytest files read EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env key) — export it before running; pytest.ini adds -n/xdist.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; minor logic/UX issues)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Created test orders/bot positions for user_test1 then POST /api/portfolio/reset; bot restored to disabled smc 1h [BTC-USD, ETH-USD, EURUSD=X]; plugins restored to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env value>; cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -o addopts='' -q. Bot opens trades readily on 5m/15m with rsi/ema_cross and trend_filter=false across many symbols. Optimizer: EURUSD=X 1h and AAPL 1d return best; BTC-USD 1h returns best=null. Selectors: segments use `${testID}-${value}` (e.g. chart-tf-5m, bt-category-forex, bt-options-trend, bot-trend-filter-trend).
rca_of_issue: Order 502: place_order calls quote(symbol) which returns None for unknown symbols -> HTTPException(502); ingress/Cloudflare then masks the JSON with an HTML 502 page. Fix: check `body.symbol in ASSET_INFO` first and raise 404.
